title: Face Sculpt #003 · 중국 30대 · 섹시한 · 애교살 초극대 · 둥근 베이비 페이스 · 메이크업 없음 · P15
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 30s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Chinese woman — Chinese poised refined beauty milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and real visible pores, mid 30s, sleek black shoulder-length hair with a side part, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has a fiery orange coloured contact lens with a thick dark outer ring and round natural pupils, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has a glowing amber-gold coloured contact lens with a heart-shaped pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, heavy-lidded eyes under half-lowered eyelids, lips slightly parted, a sultry, alluring expression — a photograph of a real Chinese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and lenses described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): large, soft, smiling eyes that curve into gentle crescents with a clearly defined double eyelid, and the signature feature of her face is her exaggerated 'aegyo-sal': a hugely plump, pillowy, rounded fat roll under each eye, twice as thick as her upper eyelid, running along the whole length of the lower lash line and bulging out like a small soft pillow, so the lower lids look round, inflated and glossy, clearly visible as a big puffy ridge with a bright pearly champagne highlighter on top of it and a soft shadow line right beneath it, which makes her eyes look like two bright smiling crescents sitting on top of two soft cushions, sweet and sparkling; the eyes are in coloured doll-eye contact lenses with a big iris, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a soft, round 'baby face' jaw: full, plump, rounded cheeks, a short, soft, rounded jawline with no sharp angles and a small, round, slightly full chin. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about twelve in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one small hoop or stud along the edge of the upper lip; one small hoop or stud across the lower lip's edge; one small ring or stud on the chin; on each ear, one large healed opening in the earlobe holding a very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above it sit one thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. A forehead pendant: a fine gold chain runs along the centre parting of her hair and ends in a teardrop gem pendant resting at the middle of her forehead. A nose-to-ear chain: a fine chain swags from the ring on her left nostril wing across the cheek, well below the eye and clear of the lips, up to a hook at the top of her left ear. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Stickers: five tiny glow-in-the-dark heart and star stickers are scattered flat on the skin of the lower cheeks and the jawline below the cheekbone studs, clear of the piercings, the eyes and the lips. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of this iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly eight separate massive weights, each of a different shape, all of them dull dark brass with a rough cast, uneven surface, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal: on the left ear a teardrop-shaped sinker on a shortest chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a shortest chain, a ship's anchor on a short chain, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a medium chain, a miniature anvil on a long chain, a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, a cube-shaped block on a longer chain, a square-sided cowbell on a longest chain; on the right ear a square-sided cowbell on a shortest chain, a pyramid-shaped lump on a shortest chain, a cube-shaped block on a short chain, a bell-shaped weight like a small temple bell with a flared rim on a medium chain, a ship's anchor on a long chain, a teardrop-shaped sinker on a long chain, a round bell on a longer chain, a hammer head on a longest chain. On each ear the single iron ring carries all the weights, hanging in a staggered cluster on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because all the load is carried by one opening, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel set with small clear diamonds, one-colour, restrained, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished brass, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
